words.sense: Sentimental longing for a remembered past
misconceptions: Confusing emotional longing with simple recollection.

words.sense: Recalling or recounting a past experience
misconceptions: Assuming a happy memory necessarily means wanting the past back.

semantic_axes.description: Nostalgia adds emotional yearning for an earlier time; reminiscence is remembering or recounting the past without requiring that longing.

edges.boundary_rule: Nostalgia adds emotional yearning for an earlier time; reminiscence is remembering or recounting the past without requiring that longing.
clues_b: retrieves details without wishing to return

misconceptions.M2: Confusing emotional longing with simple recollection.
misconceptions.M3: Assuming a happy memory necessarily means wanting the past back.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Leila's story during lunch?

beats.text: Leila recounts how she accidentally emailed her first supervisor a grocery list instead of a report.
beats.reason: The initial evidence is recounts a particular past incident; it best supports reminiscence.

beats.text: Her colleagues ask her to tell the story again because it makes them laugh.
beats.reason: Laughter does not turn a told memory into longing for an earlier life.

chains.feedback_short: Laughter does not turn a told memory into longing for an earlier life.
chains.feedback_deep: Nostalgia means wistful attachment to earlier times; reminiscence means a memory or act of remembering. Laughter does not turn a told memory into longing for an earlier life.
chains.contrast_rule: Nostalgia misses yesterday; reminiscence remembers yesterday.
